get.description: Returns the VAPID public key needed by the browser to set up a push subscription.

post.description: Registers or updates a Web Push subscription for the authenticated user. The user identity is taken from the JWT – callers cannot register on behalf of others. If the endpoint already exists for that user, its keys are refreshed.
Disables the push subscription identified by endpoint for the authenticated user. The user identity is taken from the JWT – callers cannot remove others' subscriptions.
